headline: Pakistan Cuts Petrol and High-Speed Diesel Prices in Fifth Successive Reduction
summary: Pakistan's government reduced the retail price of petrol by Rs6.59 per litre and high-speed diesel by Rs4.25 per litre, marking the fifth consecutive price reduction driven by global pricing trends.
why: Retail fuel price adjustments directly impact domestic inflation, transportation costs, and consumer purchasing power in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Lower fuel prices reduce domestic logistics costs and ease inflationary pressures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
